title: TikTok comments are getting more interactive with voice comments, polls, and more
snippet: TikTok’s comments section is getting an upgrade. The social network announced on Thursday that it’s rolling out new features for its comment sections, including voice comments, comment polls, photo carousel comments, and Live Photo comments. With the additions, the app is borrowing features from messaging apps as it looks to deepen engagement on its platform. […]

title: Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
snippet: Nvidia said Hugging Face hosts over 3 million models and is used by over 18 million developers.
